description: Search FRENCH PUBLIC-CONTRACT AWARDS (données essentielles de la commande publique / DECP) — the legally-required disclosure every French public buyer (ministries, local authorities, public hospitals, public bodies) files about a contract it has AWARDED: who bought, who won, how much, when, and under which CPV code. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "who did a French public body award a contract to", "French government contracts with company X", or "public spending on CPV code Y in France". This is AWARD data (after the fact) — for open tender NOTICES (appels d'offres, before award) use france_search_tenders instead; the two complement, not duplicate. Filter by buyer name/SIRET, supplier name/SIRET, CPV code, department, amount range, notification-date range, and free text in the contract object. Keyword searches are answered from a stored copy of the last 24 months of awards (answered_from: stored_copy; every word must appear in the contract object; coverage and data_as_of are stated; sole traders under a personal name are withheld); searches without a keyword go live. Returns total_matches plus the matching contracts, newest notification first by default.

buyer_name.description: Substring match on the awarding public buyer's name (acheteur), e.g. "VILLE DE PARIS", "REGION GRAND EST".

buyer_siret.description: Exact 14-digit SIRET/SIREN of the awarding public buyer.

cpv_code.description: CPV (Common Procurement Vocabulary) code, exact 8-digit code or a leading-digits prefix, e.g. "45000000" for all construction works, "45233140" for road works.

department_code.description: French department code of the AWARDING BUYER, e.g. "75" (Paris), "13" (Bouches-du-Rhône), "2A"/"2B" (Corsica).

keyword.description: Free-text search within the contract object/description (objet), e.g. "informatique", "voirie", "nettoyage", "cloud". All words must appear; whole words, accents/case/plurals ignored. Served from the 24-month stored copy.

limit.description: Number of contracts to return (1-100). Default 20.

max_amount.description: Maximum contract amount in euros (montant, HT).

min_amount.description: Minimum contract amount in euros (montant, HT).

offset.description: Result offset for pagination within the matched set. Default 0.

sort.description: Sort order. Default date_desc (most recently notified first).

supplier_name.description: Substring match on the awarded supplier's name (titulaire), e.g. "VEOLIA", "VINCI".

supplier_siret.description: Exact 14-digit SIRET of the awarded supplier.

name: fr_decp_search_contracts

answered_from.description: stored_copy: the 24-month stored copy answered (every keyword search). live: the publisher's query service answered.

category.description: Null when the buyer category (acheteur_categorie) is not published for this award.

individual_name_withheld.description: True when the supplier is a sole trader under a personal name; name and siret are then withheld.

coverage.description: Stored copy only: the window the copy covers and the range actually searched.

data_as_of.description: The publisher's own date for the file (stored: the file the copy was loaded from; live: the resource's last-modified date), never today's date; null with data_as_of_note when it could not be read.

individuals.description: Stored copy only: states that sole traders under a personal name are withheld, and how many stored awards are affected.

keyword_matches.description: Stored copy only: awards in the window with every keyword word in the contract object, before other filters.

reads.description: Stored copy only: objects and bytes read from the stored copy for this call.

stored_copy.description: Present on a live answer to a keyword search: why the stored copy did not answer (not_loaded, store_unavailable, date_range_outside_stored_window, keyword_has_no_searchable_word).

total_matches.description: Count of awards passing every filter; null when filters beyond the keyword could only be checked on the newest keyword matches (see keyword_matches and note).

title: Fr Decp Search Contracts
